mission_priority: XRP intelligence and measured prediction-engine mastery
foundation: Barrot V3 execution, security, verification and preservation

limitations: liquidations are at least values because exchange feeds are incomplete
long/short is account share, not notional exposure

coverage: linear perpetuals settled in USDT or USDC

market.aggregation_policy: Do not average provider OI. Observations are asynchronous and represent different contract/exchange universes.

methodology.data: public spot order-book APIs; median daily depth

xrp_median_depth.market_structure: buy-side skew; depth more evenly distributed through the range than 2025

venue_interpretation.at_touch: Binance has largest depth at zero deviation
venue_interpretation.through_2_pct: CoinGecko's median curve says Coinbase retains dominance through the ±2% range
venue_interpretation.buy_side: Coinbase has a higher proportion of bids than asks relative to Binance and Bitget

event_observations.detail: Coinbase held deepest XRP liquidity through most of ±2%, about $8M combined; Crypto.com surpassed it beyond ±2%.

Coinbase and Crypto.com showed roughly $7M more buy-side depth beyond ±1%, while total market depth remained near the daily median; report interprets this as order repositioning by existing traders rather than clear new capital.
Coinbase showed abnormally large sell orders, taking cumulative sell-side depth above $5M at selected deviations; order-book composition can reverse.

coinbase_liquidity.interpretation: Coinbase has a measured near-mid and median depth-range advantage in this dated sample, while Binance leads at the touch. Resting orders are cancelable and are not executed volume, net capital inflow, market control or proof of institutional buying.

xrpl_amendment.name: fixCleanup3_4_0
xrpl_amendment.reconciliation: The different 35/36 denominators are not treated as a direct contradiction. XRPL's official docs state that only validators trusted by a server count; each server's trusted validator list/UNL and observation cutoff must accompany a vote snapshot. These are different tracker/node vantage points and cutoffs.
xrpl_amendment.activation_sequence: Maintain >80% support continuously for two weeks; voting is interpreted at a flag ledger; an EnableAmendment pseudo-transaction records the result; the amendment applies from the subsequent ledger. Verify the validated-ledger transaction, not only the projected date.
xrpl_amendment.scope: Maintenance/fix bundle covering vaults, lending code paths, AMM, permissioned DEX, trust lines, NFTs, MPTs, escrow, sponsorship, signing and permission delegation.
non_implications: Does not create a native XRP-collateralized lending market
Does not alter XRP holder balances or create a token swap

circle_event.status: Upcoming; no Q3 results claimed before publication

hypotheses.hypothesis: Positive OI change, positive aggregate funding and 74.8% long account share indicate crowded long positioning and possible liquidation sensitivity.
hypotheses.disconfirming_or_alternative: Bybit funding is negative; account counts are not notional; long liquidation data is incomplete and does not establish net directional exposure.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coinbase's near-mid and median depth-range position may make it important for institutional execution and price discovery.
hypotheses.disconfirming_or_alternative: Study is dated Jul-Sep, order-book orders can be cancelled, Binance leads at the touch, and no live Coinbase book or executed-flow attribution is included.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Escrow unlock windows can coincide with repositioning of resting bids without increasing total market depth.
hypotheses.disconfirming_or_alternative: No account-level order lineage proves the same traders moved orders; order-book snapshots cannot identify owners.

hypotheses.hypothesis: fixCleanup3_4_0 activation may reduce protocol implementation risk for affected features.
hypotheses.disconfirming_or_alternative: It is a maintenance bundle; native lending amendments remain below threshold; no causal XRP price effect is established.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Circle/SBI/Coinbase stablecoin distribution and XRPL support can increase institutional payment-rail optionality around XRP.
hypotheses.disconfirming_or_alternative: Stablecoin activity is not XRP purchases; USDC and RLUSD can be complementary or substitutive; no XRP-specific flow attribution is available.

source_register.kind: research report using exchange public APIs

blockers: current executable Coinbase and cross-venue books
settled ETF flows with consistent universe
immutable source snapshots and cutoff enforcement

limitations: No exchange-level raw order-book replay was collected in this run.
CoinGecko's report is a 60-day historical sample, not current executable liquidity.
TradRadar and Kodexius OI universes differ; no canonical global OI is asserted.
ETF providers have different fund universes and settlement status; no final November 2 aggregate is asserted.
No actual XRP-specific institutional flow is inferred from stablecoin circulation, ETF assets, exchange balances or resting orders.
fixCleanup3_4_0 has not yet been verified active through a validated EnableAmendment ledger transaction.
